method: Direct image view of all 29 distinct native PNG byte groups; the 57 originals remain preserved. Exact duplicate hashes establish that the other captures show the same pixels, not additional independent visual contexts.
nativePaintProbeInspection: Verified 140 individual and 8 whole-word probe records/assertions. Their bitmap hashes are not visual inspection of 148 separate raster PNGs: the fixture recycles those bitmaps. Visual readability inspected in all three actual Compose PNG panels, covering all 35 scoped Han in each of the four production families.

observations.scope: Three actual font panels; 35 Han across Gothic, Mincho, Textbook and Brush
observations.result: No blank, replacement box or materially misleading scoped glyph observed. Characters remain legible in every family. 冠 is distinguishable from 冗, 完 and 守; 元 and 寸 remain distinguishable.
observations.specificFallback: 冖 is the cover without the upper dot; 宀 shows the upper dot. Both remain distinct in all four rows, including the bundled-family rows whose cmaps omit them. Those glyphs can share a fallback appearance; no exact system font face is inferred from pixels or hashes.

observations.scope: Complete 冠 kanji article, complete 王冠 support article, complete reused 冠 word and changed 王 counterpart passage
observations.result: Meaning/origin qualifiers, both reading examples, common words, reading-specific peerless caveat, ceremonial headgear, royal crown versus bottle closure, component links, readings/translations and source notes are readable over the captured scroll states. The six mapped link directions and system-Back route were asserted in the actual native case.
observations.horizontalTable: Default table states crop the rightmost ceremonial-cap gloss; the page explicitly instructs sideways scrolling. The captures for the example cells show the complete gloss after horizontal positioning, with the leftmost reading column then partly off-screen. Both readings and both full examples are visible across those states, not all columns simultaneously. This is supported table navigation, not a missing reading or text.

observations.result: N1 is selected with 111 cards. The actual meaning task shows 冠 and the target crown; peerless, alongside exempt; be spared, superfluous; redundant and frugal; thrifty. The selected answer and green Correct feedback are visible.

The on question shows カン among ケン, ハン and ジョウ, and feedback marks カン correct. The kun question shows かんむり among かねる, しおり and かつら, and feedback marks かんむり correct. Completion shows 2 of 2 correct. Native assertions also verified the exact normalized keys and two persisted good logs.

observations.scope: Nine-stroke trace, shape-only feedback and give-up recall
observations.result: Trace/reference geometry and both feedback panels depict recognizable 冠. Trace feedback explicitly says practice only, not graded; the shape-only comparison shows injected reference strokes beside correct strokes. Recall give-up shows a blank attempt and the reference character, followed by the asserted grade-1 log on Next.
observations.limit: Initial trace PNG reports first-use handwriting-model download. Offline shape-only feedback explicitly reports the handwriting model unavailable. This checks production drawing/shape comparison/reference navigation, not downloaded-model recognition, independent human handwriting, successful memory recall or learning effectiveness.

limits: Author/coordinator visual inspection is not either required original-family independent visual confirmation; those two serial confirmations remain pending.
Read-only API35 emulator, not physical-phone evidence or native-speaker certification.
Injected reference paths and give-up recall do not establish handwriting-model recognition or human learning effectiveness.
No fresh all-40 fallback-target audit or prior pilot inspections; unchanged production-font evidence is inherited with its original limitations.
No content publication, current-main integration, CI or immutable GitHub archive acceptance is claimed.
